**Job Title: Plant Manager**

**Job Type: On-Site**

**Location: Orange, CA**

**Reporting to: VP of Manufacturing**

**Company Overview**

FXI is a leading producer of foam innovation in the Bedding, Furniture, Industrial, Home & Office, Healthcare, and Transportation markets. We have made it our mission to provide tailored solutions that delight our customers and consumers. With our corporate headquarters, high-tech research and development facility, and multiple manufacturing locations in North America, FXI has built a culture of innovation and achievement that is recognized by customers, suppliers and peers. Our products include finished goods, sub-assemblies, services, and raw materials for OEMs, fabricators, and retailers. You will find FXI's foam innovations inside, around, and under yourself in countless applications. Everywhere foam goes, FXI's innovations lead the way! Won't you join us?

**Job Overview:**

Reporting to the Manufacturing Vice President, the Plant Manager plans, directs, and coordinates the operations of the plant. The Plant Manager has leadership responsibility to assure compliance with all government and company policies and procedures. This position will also be responsible for facility production goals and objectives. Following FXI's Vision, Mission and Values, the Plant Manager is to develop a well-trained and motivated staff with emphasis on plant safety and employee engagement.

**Responsibilities:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Chemical, or related discipline) preferred.

* Direct and coordinate plant operations in strict compliance with all state and federal laws, regulations, corporate policies and procedures
* Responsible for achieving all facility business goals including, but not limited to, the areas of safety, quality, production, reliability and P&L.

* Maintain a clean and safe plant; incorporate a 5S culture for conducting all work activities.

* Develop and foster a high‑performing, well‑trained, and motivated workforce by assessing current skill sets and aligning talent development with the plant's future growth, vision, and manufacturing excellence across all functions.

* Lead the development, implementation, and governance of plant performance metrics and KPIs to monitor progress toward site objectives and drive continuous improvement.

* Conduct and assure all required employee development and performance reviews are completed to promote individual continuous improvement per the required corporate schedule.

* Attend scheduled corporate training and meetings. Need to be a key leader moving the company forward to meet strategic and business plan objectives.
* Ensures that all plant assets are properly managed, safeguarded, and secure.

* Develop, submit for approval, and implement approved Capital Projects as required to meet facility strategic plans and business needs.

* Develop and ensure management systems are in place to monitor plant output, cuts / yields and scrap to ensure efficient resource utilization and initiate corrective action as required.

* Establish and maintain a positive community relationship.

**Qualifications:**

* 10 years of prior experience in a manufacturing environment
* Prior experience as Production / Operations Manager.
* Strong interpersonal, problem solving and leadership skills with the ability to lead a team motivate the group and manage a diverse workforce.
* Excellent, engaging communicator; able to set measurable goals and expectations and hold team members accountable for results

* Demonstrated experience and working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles and structured problem‑solving tools (e.g., 5S, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, Root Cause Analysis, A3, 5 Whys) to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.

* Action-oriented and eager to drive programs through to completion. Able to deal with pressures and timelines inherent in a fast-paced company
* Ability to quickly assess the situation at the plant and have an impact on the direction of improvements
* Ability to function as a strong leader, bringing the Operations perspective while promoting cross-functional horizontal alignment to achieve key company goals
* Hands-on leader who contributes to overall business strategy and issues, works well as part of the leadership team, and is focused upon achieving results
* Team player and coach who will promote cooperation among employees in the organization and an environment of employee engagement
* Possess the confidence and presence to be able to deal effectively with external customers, vendors, and all levels within the organization
* Strong, self-confident, decisive leader with excellent listening skills, emotional maturity, and ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment

**Our Commitment to a Diverse Workforce:** FXI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. FXI does not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or based on any individual's membership in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. We support workplace diversity. We strongly believe that diversity contributes to a broader collective perspective that will consistently lead to a better company and better products. We are working hard to increase the diversity of our team wherever we can.

***We are interested in every*** ***qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.***

FXI is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. Please, no phone calls or emails. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at FXI via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of FXI. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by FXI as a result of the referral or through other means.

card.description:
**Plant Manager I**

850 W Gowen Rd, Boise, ID 83705, USA

Full-time

**Job Description**

Norco is currently seeking an individual to fill our Plant Manager I position. The Plant Manager I is accountable for the overall safe, compliant, reliable, efficient, and financially responsible operation of the production facility. The position establishes facility strategy and operating priorities, develops the leadership team, allocates resources, manages operational and regulatory risk, drives performance, and leads long-term improvement to support production capacity, customer service, and business continuity. Other responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

**Plant Leadership and Strategy**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for the production facility and assigned support functions.
* Establish facility goals, staffing plans, operating priorities, budgets, capital priorities, reliability priorities, and improvement strategies.
* Maintain overall facility accountability for employee safety, product quality, regulatory compliance, customer service, production capacity, equipment reliability, operating cost, inventory control, and business continuity.
 

**Leadership Development and Organizational Capability**

* Build, direct, and develop the plant leadership team; establish clear accountability for supervisors and managers; assess leadership effectiveness; and maintain succession and development plans for critical facility roles.
* Approve or recommend hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, and termination decisions within assigned authority.

**Operational and Financial Performance**

* Review plant performance through KPI's, safety, quality, production, service, labor, training, inventory, maintenance, downtime, and financial measures.
* Require recovery plans and corrective action when plant or department performance does not meet expectations.
* Plan and request approval for operating expenditures, capital projects, staffing changes, and other resources needed to meet business requirements.
* Balance production capacity, service requirements, operating cost, equipment reliability, inventory, and plant resources when making operating decisions.
* Approve major operating commitments and significant resource decisions within assigned authority.

**Safety, Quality, and Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure operations are conducted in accordance with applicable company safety rules, procedures, work instructions, quality requirements, and assigned personal protective equipment requirements.
* Ensure required production and regulated records receive review and approval by properly trained and authorized personnel.
* Lead or oversee significant incidents, root-cause analyses, corrective actions, audit responses, product-quality events, regulatory interactions, service disruptions, and business-continuity responses. 
 Cross-Functional Leadership
* Coordinate significant facility matters with Gas Operations, Quality, Safety, Human Resources, Sales, Customer Service, Distribution, Maintenance, Procurement, Finance, Information Technology, and branch leadership.
* Communicate plant risks, performance, operating constraints, resource needs, and significant decisions clearly and promptly to appropriate stakeholders.
* Participate in company planning, leadership meetings, management reviews, emergency response, and special projects.
* Maintain sufficient technical knowledge to evaluate operating risk and make informed management decisions.
* Stay informed of and adhere to company policies and procedures.

**Supervision**

* Incumbent works under general supervision and exercises substantial independent judgment within established company policies, approved budgets, regulatory requirements, and assigned authority.

**Organizational Role**

* Manager - plans and assigns work to accomplish facility and departmental goals; responsible for leadership, hiring, employee development, performance management, resource allocation, and operating outcomes for assigned employees and functions.

**Qualifications**

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Five years of progressively responsible experience in production, manufacturing, compressed gas, chemical processing, distribution, or a related operational environment.
* Three years of successful experience leading supervisors, departments, or comparable operational workgroups.
* Equivalent combinations of education, training, and relevant experience may be considered.
* Valid driver's license.
* Forklift certification or ability to become certified if required.
* Comprehensive understanding of production leadership, safety management, quality systems, regulatory compliance, operating risk, budgeting, capital planning, and resource allocation.
* Working knowledge of industrial, medical, specialty, and fuel gases; cylinders; production equipment; cylinder maintenance; material handling; loading; and related plant operations.
* Ability to lead managers and supervisors, establish accountability, develop employees, and support succession planning.
* Strong judgment regarding safety, regulatory, legal, operational, customer-service, reputational, and financial risk.
* Excellent organizational, decision-making, root-cause analysis, change-management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to analyze operational and financial measures and translate findings into effective priorities and corrective actions.
* Ability to communicate concisely with employees, branch personnel, company leadership, customers, contractors, auditors, and regulators.
* Ability to safely handle compressed gas cylinders and use material-handling aids as required.

**Preferred Education and Experience**:

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, physical science, operations management, or a related field.
* Experience in compressed gas production, medical gas production, specialty gas operations, fuel gas operations, cylinder maintenance, or regulated manufacturing.
* Experience with quality assurance, audits, regulated documentation, budgets, capital projects, reliability, and continuous improvement.

**Additional information**

Norco offers a competitive compensation/benefit package, including:

* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
* Health, Vision and Dental Insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Medical and Dependent Care Flex Accounts (FSA)
* Life Insurance provided at no cost to employee by Norco
* Supplemental Accident, Disease, and Life Insurance options
* Employee Tuition Reimbursement
* 401(k) with Employer Matching
* Employee Discount on products sold by Norco

**Company Description**

Founded in 1948, Norco is headquartered in Boise, Idaho and has more than 70 branches in Idaho, Montana, Oregon, Nevada, Washington, Utah and Wyoming. As a family and employee owned company we operate the nation's largest independent gas manufacturer/distributor of welding, safety, medical equipment and supplies. Norco is proud to be among the thousands of privately-owned businesses nationwide that offer their employees a meaningful stake in the business through employee stock ownership (ESOP).

At Norco we share a common mission: "Serving You Better." Treating customers, suppliers and each other with respect and dignity is our top priority. We work hard every day to serve others and create rich lives for our employees, their families, and the communities where we work and live.

**Norco, Inc is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer**

Norco provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

**Norco, Inc is a Drug-Free workplace.**

card.title: Plant Manager B Shift
card.description:
The Plant Manager is responsible for coordinating, directing, leading, guiding, and managing areas of the plant consistent with company policies and procedures as well as with federal, state and local law. Will be accountable for the management and safety of employees, high quality products being produced, budgeting and the profitability of the facility. The Plant Manager develops processes that will maximize stewardship, safety, quality, culture, customer relations, and productivity. This role has direct supervisory responsibility for all operations management and hourly team members with an expanded dotted line responsibility for a variety of support groups when department heads are not present (i.e., Sanitation, Shipping, Maintenance & Engineering). Will work closely with Human Resources and production teams in hire and train staff.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**: This list is not intended to be all-inclusive and other duties may be assigned.

* Initiate and maintain a safe workplace in accordance with regulatory and plant policies by maintaining effective safety and ergonomic programs and proactively correcting deficiencies to meet company goals of an injury free workplace.
* Responsible for communicating necessary feedback updates, up through STF leadership that pertain to the shift's activities.
* Be an active member, leading and facilitating our Safety Committee.
* Implement and attain goals to reduce injuries and cost per claim of injuries.
* Responsible for team members for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of all shift operations; ensure all operating procedures are followed and correct and/or update when needed.
* Ensure employee safety training, assist in the identification of and correction of safety hazards and ergonomic issues.
* Ensure all staff and employees know and understand CCP's, HACCP and SSOP documents/plans.
* Maintain product failures and foreign material issues are kept at a minimum; continue efforts for improvement.
* Responsible for overseeing all plant activity within all departments of the shift including supporting areas.
* Serve as a contact person for vendors and suppliers.
* Initiate and modify as necessary methods of ensuring production goals are met, including product quality per food safety requirements and specifications, efficiency, hours, cost and safety to remain efficient and competitive.
* Develop and manage a system that tracks labor, product and packaging costs that result in a reduction to the budget.
* Carries out managerial/supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the companies policies and applicable laws.
* Responsible for plant labor, raw material utilization, yields, supplies and waste reduction to ensure they are being managed in the most efficient manner.
* Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, training employees, planning, directing and assigning work; appraising performance; rewarding and counseling employees when necessary to maintain a high standard of employee relations.
* Facilitate training and development sessions that develops the skills and education of company leaders.
* Develop and manage a strong productive working relationship with the UFCW, Local 2. Ensuring compliance with our collective bargaining agreement.

**QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS**: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the work environment, knowledge, skill, and/or ability required or preferred. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**: Bachelor's degree in a related field (agriculture, animal science or business) plus ten years of plant experience or the combination of education and experience that enables performance in all aspects of the position, including supervisory experience. Well-developed management skills utilizing sound management principles in leading a team of employees.

**COMMUNICATION SKILLS**: Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to write reports and business correspondence. Ability to effectively manage time and meet all specified deadlines.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**: Ability to read and interpret documents in the English language such as safety files, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Must be able to effectively communicate with USDA, production and management personnel.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS**: Ability to apply mathematical applications to practical situations.

**REASONING ABILITY**: Ability to solve practical problems. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form.

**OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES**: Ability to use computers and all standard programs used by the industry and the ability to learn and effectively use any and all other computer programs that are or will be made available.

**BACKUP PERSONNEL**: In the absence of the Plant Manager, the Plant Superintendent will assume responsibilities for overseeing food safety and quality assurance programs.

**MISSION, VISION, & VALUES:** Must believe and lead STF's **MISSION** of producing quality pork products, igniting the passion and growth of our team members, helping our community thrive, and making our business prosperous. Remembering that together we will achieve more by working safely and cultivating an inclusive and empowering environment. Must believe and fully engage in STF's **VISION** of being a place where we all belong, working as one, to build our future. Must live STF's **VALUES** in all decisions, behaviors, and interactions, which include-

SAFETY- Be committed to the safety and welfare of all employees through prevention, education, and awareness, with the ultimate goal of eliminating workplace accidents.

QUALITY- Our customers and families depend on us to provide a safe, quality product, by maintaining the highest food safety standards and desired customer specifications. Must take pride in the products we produce and serve.

DIVERSITY- We embrace diversity of identity, experience, and thought, and actively strive for inclusive behaviors across our company and our work. By promoting these values, we aim to create a positive work experience that encourage a sense of belonging.

COMMUNITY- Be a positive representative of STF in our community while supporting the organizations who work for the betterment of Siouxland.

SUSTAINABILITY- Be a steward of the earth by managing our environmental footprint.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**: While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be required to move about the facility. The employee is frequently required to stand; walk; use hands to finger; handle; or feel/hold objects; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; speak; hear taste and smell. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Individual must be able to effectively work in a normal production environment where temperatures and noise levels may vary.

card.title: Director of Manufacturing Operations
card.description:
Airlite Plastics is a premier, privately held, family-owned manufacturer headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska. Our family style and personal culture is what makes Airlite an amazing place to grow and build a successful career. Airlite’s company values of unquestionable integrity and respect and appreciation for each other are at the core of our success! These values set a strong foundation to build on where we can ‘wow’ our customers with innovative products and sustainable solutions and continuously improve our processes and efficiencies.

 

Our product lines include rigid plastic containers and lids for food packaging and cosmetics, dry powder scoops, plastic drink cups, shipping containers, industrial strength insulated concrete forms (ICF) and sustainable permeable paving systems. As pioneers in our industry, focused on sustainable solutions, we strive to provide our customers with top-notch service and quality, which aligns with our award-winning products.

 

As Airlite continues to grow and expand, we are excited to add new roles across our organization to support increasing customer demand and future innovation. This is an exciting time to join our team and be part of a company investing in people, technology, and long-term success.

 

**How would you contribute?**

This role is a contributing member of our team located in Nazareth, PA. As a Director of Operations you are a key to continued growth and success of Airlite. The Director of Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for manufacturing operations across assigned Airlite Locations. This role is responsible for Production, Maintenance, and Engineering and ensures operational strategies, resources, and priorities are aligned with business objectives.

This role will drive operational excellence through strong leadership, development of site leadership teams, continuous improvement, effective use of performance metrics, and disciplined execution. A key focus of this position is building leadership capability throughout the organization by coaching and developing managers and supervisors as the operations continue to grow and evolve. The Director will balance consistent operational expectations across locations while recognizing the unique needs and autonomy of each facility.

**Essential Duties:**

* Provide strategic leadership and direction for Production, Maintenance, and Engineering across the Nazareth and Lakeville facilities.

* Lead, coach, and develop operational leaders, strengthening leadership capability, accountability, decision-making, and succession readiness throughout the organization.

* Establish operational priorities, goals, and KPIs and use performance data to drive accountability and continuous improvement.

* Ensure manufacturing operations consistently achieve objectives related to safety, quality, delivery, productivity, efficiency, and cost.

* Partner with site leadership to develop and execute operational plans that support business growth, capacity requirements, equipment needs, and organizational objectives.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve manufacturing processes, equipment reliability, labor effectiveness, throughput, and overall operational performance.

* Provide leadership for capital projects, equipment installations, process improvements, and other operational initiatives in partnership with Engineering and Maintenance.

* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing, and leadership needs and develop teams capable of supporting current operations and future growth.

* Promote consistency and sharing of best practices between facilities while allowing each operation to respond effectively to its specific business and manufacturing needs.

* Partner cross-functionally with Quality, Supply Chain, Safety, Human Resources, Finance, Sales, Customer Service, and other functions to resolve issues and achieve business objectives.

* Develop and manage operational budgets, forecasts, capital requirements, and resource plans in alignment with financial and strategic objectives.

* Foster a culture of safety, accountability, collaboration, employee development, continuous improvement, and operational excellence while exemplifying Airlite's Core Values and servant leadership principles.

* Other duties as assigned.

 

**Do you have what it takes?** Airlite Plastics is a versatile employer; complacency is not one of our strengths! We work hard each day to ensure that equipment efficiency and customer satisfaction never leave our line of sight. Successful candidates for the role will possess the following:

 

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, Manufacturing, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including significant responsibility for manufacturing operations.
* 5+ years of experience leading managers and/or senior operational leaders.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing multiple operational functions such as Production, Maintenance, and Engineering.
* Experience leading operations across multiple facilities or business units strongly preferred.
* Experience with capital planning, operational budgeting, continuous improvement, and manufacturing performance management.
* Plastics manufacturing, injection molding, extrusion, or related manufacturing experience preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and develop managers and emerging leaders.
* Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to understand the impact of operational decisions on overall business performance.
* Ability to effectively lead across multiple facilities, balancing consistent operational expectations with the unique needs of each location.
* Capability to solve complex problems, utilizing strong critical thinking and decision-making skills
* Superior organizational skills and the ability to assemble resources needed to orchestrate multiple projects/activities and accomplish goals
* Model a collaborative leadership style with the ability to build partnerships and influence others into action
* Excellent verbal and written communications skills
* Outstanding presentation and facilitation skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills and consultative approach; tactful in dealing with people at all levels
* Strong sense of urgency, self-motivated and positive
* Flexible and adaptable; able to work in ambiguous situations
* Ability to actively lead change initiatives
* Display highest ethical standards
* Maintain the utmost level of confidentiality in dealing with sensitive information
* Detail oriented, with the ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment

 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; stand; walk; use hand dexterity to operate office equipment including computer keyboards; reach with hands and arms; and talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be exposed to moving mechanical parts. The noise level in the office work environment is typically quiet; when visiting the production floor, the noise level may be loud.

 

**Our Core Values Drive Us!**

 

* Do you conduct yourself with unquestionable integrity?

* Do you demonstrate respect and appreciation for those around you?

* Are you innovative and strive to challenge the status quo?

* Do you strive for continuous improvement and to deliver the “wow” factor?

* Do you care about environmentally sustainable solutions?

* Do you take meaning and pride in a job well done?

 

**What’s in it for you?** ***As a Full-Time employee, you will be eligible for the following benefits:***

 

* Health, dental and vision insurance

* Company paid life insurance

* Company paid short term disability

* Generous 401k match

* Generous Time Off

* Annual company activities

card.description:
**If you are currently employed at Smithfield, please log into Workday and submit your application through the Jobs Hub.**

Have a seat at our table. When you join Smithfield, you become part of something special – a company that's sustainably feeding people around the world, producing good food the right way with respect for our people, animals, communities and planet. With opportunities across locations and functions, a culture grounded in our Core Four values - gratitude, communication, respect and accountability - and a strong commitment to learning, collaboration, and innovation, Smithfield offers challenging and rewarding careers where you can grow, contribute and make a real impact. **Apply Now!**

**THE VALUE YOU’LL BRING:**

*The position summary states the general nature and purpose of the job. Overall accountabilities are defined in this section.*

 

As the **Director of IT Plant Systems** , you will lead the Plant IT Systems Managers and their teams responsible for delivering and supporting technology solutions across Smithfield’s manufacturing and warehousing operations. You will champion standardization, continuous improvement, and operational excellence by guiding your team to implement scalable, high-quality solutions that enhance productivity and support the company’s strategic initiatives. This role requires strong leadership, deep understanding of process manufacturing, and the ability to build trusted partnerships across Operations and IT, while establishing one consistent Plant IT operating model across the manufacturing network.

 
 

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

*The below statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. May perform other duties as assigned.*

* **Plant Operations Partnership:** Serve as the strategic IT partner to Manufacturing leadership. Ensure Plant IT Systems Managers build strong relationships with Plant Managers and leadership.
* **Plant IT Leadership:** Lead, coach, and develop Plant IT Systems Managers. Establish clear accountability for site coverage, escalation, performance, talent development, and service delivery.

* **Plant-Floor Engagement:** Build a strong IT presence in the plants through regular plant visits, operational reviews, and frontline engagement. Ensure IT teams understand production processes.

* **Operational Reliability:** Establish accountability for the availability and resilience of plant IT. Partner across IT to eliminate recurring issues, address root causes, and minimize disruption.

* **Technology Delivery & Site Readiness:** Provide Plant IT leadership for initiatives from planning and readiness through deployment, stabilization, adoption, and transition to support.

* **Portfolio & Priority Management:** Partner with Manufacturing and IT leaders to identify, prioritize, and govern plant technology demand. Balance safety, business continuity, and operational risk, regulatory requirements, business value, capacity, dependencies, and strategic alignment.

* **Standardization & Simplification:** Establish common Plant IT processes, standards, documentation, escalation practices, support models, and deployment.

* **Cross-Functional Coordination:** Act as an integration point among Plant Operations, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Manufacturing Technology, and Supply Chain.

* **Lifecycle, Governance & Risk:** Maintain visibility to plant technology assets, application dependencies, lifecycle risks, obsolescence, supportability, and cybersecurity exposure. Establish governance and escalation for risks that could affect production or business continuity.

* **Continuous Improvement & Innovation:** Identify opportunities to improve plant performance through better use of existing technology, process simplification, digital capabilities, and data.

* **Service Management:** Establish consistent expectations for incident, problem, change. Use service metrics, production-impact analysis, and recurring issue trends to improve Plant IT performance.

* **Executive Communication:** Provide concise, outcome-oriented visibility to Manufacturing and IT leadership regarding technology performance, major incidents, investment priorities, and value.

* **People & Culture:** Build a high-performing, collaborative Plant IT organization through clear expectations, coaching, career development, succession planning, accountability.
 

 

**WHAT WE’RE SEEKING:**

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential functions.*

* **Education & Experience:** Bachelor's Degree from an accredited four-year college or university and 10+ years of relevant experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience, required.
* **Leadership Experience:** 5+ years of experience in team management/development required.
* **Manufacturing Expertise:** Hands-on experience with manufacturing systems is required, including MES, SCADA, automation, quality control, labeling, or compliance systems.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Proven experience leading teams that support and troubleshoot industrial PCs, labelers, scales, and RF scanning equipment.
* **Problem-Solving & Analysis:** Strong critical thinking, decision-making, and analytical problem-solving skills; self-directed and proactive in identifying solutions.
* **Collaboration & Communication:** Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with a proven ability to work across all levels of the organization and cross-functional teams.
* **Work Environment & Travel:** Must be able to travel up to 30%, depending on project and plant support needs.
* **Organizational Skills:** Strong organizational abilities with a track record of managing complex initiatives effectively.
* **Work Style & Values:** Respectful, approachable, and team-oriented, with a focus on fostering a positive work environment and strong working relationships.
 

 
 

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

*The physical demands described here are representative of those an employee should possess to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* The majority of the time is spent in an office setting outside of the production plant. The plant environment will include wet or humid conditions (non-weather related), extreme cold and heat (non-weather related), working near moving mechanical parts, exposure to fumes or airborne particles, and chemicals.
* Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate but can be loud when in the production area.
* Frequently required to sit; stand; reach with hands and arms; use hands to handle or feel; and talk or hear.
* Specific vision abilities required include close vision and ability to adjust focus.
* Regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds; Occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.



Relocation Package Available

Yes



**EEO Information**

*Smithfield is an equal opportunity employer committed to workplace diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, gender identity, protected veterans status, status as a disabled individual or any other protected group status or non-job characteristic as directed by law.*

*If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment selection process, please call us at 757-357-1595.*

**Job Details:**

card.description:
**Win at Wilsonart**
====================

At Wilsonart, we don’t just make surfaces—we build careers. When you join our team, you become part of something bigger: a company driven by innovation, grounded in values, and powered by people who care.

You’ll be surrounded by teammates who take pride in their work and look out for one another. You’ll have the chance to learn, grow and make a real impact. And you’ll be part of a company that believes winning means helping you succeed at work and in life.

Here, you’ll win with:

Support that keeps you well

* Medical, dental, and life insurance
* Company-paid short- and long-term disability
* FSAs and dependent care options
* Vision and legal benefits
* Gym discounts and wellness clinics
* Tuition reimbursement—for you and your dependents

Opportunities to grow

* Clear paths to promotion and internal mobility
* Training, coaching, and mentorship
* Development programs to support your goals

Time for what matters

* Paid vacation and holidays in your first year
* A culture that respects work-life balance

**Job Description:**

**JOB SUMMARY**

Owns overall site performance and full P&L responsibility for the plant. Accountable for delivering Safety, Quality, Customer Service, and Cost commitments while building the organization, systems, and continuous improvement capability required to scale the operation from commissioning through full-rate production.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**P&L & Cost Management**

* Owns the plant P&L: develops, proposes, and manages the annual operating and capital budgets; drives cost, margin, and productivity performance against plan and explains variances with corrective action plans.
* Reviews, proposes, and approves as appropriate plans controlling budget spending, labor efficiency, material efficiency, engineering effectiveness, and customer service.
* Reviews cost control reports, cost estimates, headcount utilization, and conversion cost per unit for the operation.
* Reviews and proposes projects involving functional or organizational changes within the operation; builds the business case and tracks realized benefit.

**Operations & Production Standards**

* Maintains production operations standards consistent with company and site Safety, Quality, Productivity, and Cost requirements in order to exceed customer expectations (annual plant objectives and monthly scorecard).
* Reviews performance against operating plans and standards; requires interpretation of results from direct reports and approves changes in direction of plans.
* Resolves priority conflicts across lines and ensures lines are balanced and performing according to planning system rules.

**Continuous Improvement & Growth**

* Drives volume growth and productivity improvement by implementing Lean and continuous improvement methodologies across coating, curing, digital print, and material handling operations.
* Develops short- and long-term plans and programs for plant growth, including capacity, staffing, and capital investment roadmaps.
* Facilitates new product and new substrate/chemistry launches to assure successful implementation and rapid qualification.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Coordinates with support functions (Supply Chain and Planning, Continuous Improvement, Quality, Safety, Engineering, Finance, and Human Resources) to establish and implement systems supporting production operations goals.
* Partners with commercial teams on customer commitments, service levels, and cost-to-serve.

**People Leadership**

* Selects, develops, and retains qualified personnel in all positions reporting directly or indirectly; provides training, guidance, performance appraisals, and career development.

**Safety, Quality & Compliance**

* Responsible for compliance with all regulatory, corporate, and local policies (safety, environmental, quality, employment).
* Ensures a safe working environment and personally models and promotes safe work practices throughout the operation.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering or Business discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5+ years of experience in successful manufacturing operations, with demonstrated ownership of cost or P&L performance.
* 2+ years of experience in a direct people leadership position, with a track record of growing and developing direct reports.
* Familiarity with ERP systems (Oracle or equivalent) in a plant or departmental leadership capacity is a plus.

**Certifications & Licenses**

* Lean/Six Sigma certification preferred

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**

* Demonstrated track record applying Lean manufacturing techniques and leading in a team-based work environment.
* Business Operating System experience: Familiarity with Business Operating/Quality Systems or a comparable Lean Continuous Improvement framework, along with the analytical tools that support it, 80/20 root cause analysis, problem solving tool deployment, statistical process control (SPC), 5S, etc., with a demonstrated ability to use data to drive measurable improvements in safety, quality, OTIF and productivity.
* Business acumen and cost consciousness: understands the business implications of decisions, works within approved budgets, proactively develops cost-saving measures, and contributes to profit and revenue.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills; presents numerical data effectively to plant, functional, and executive audiences.Owns overall site performance and full P&L responsibility for the plant. Accountable for delivering Safety, Quality, Customer Service, and Cost commitments while building the organization, systems, and continuous improvement capability required to scale the operation from commissioning through full-rate production.

*We’re looking for people who are ready to learn, ready to lead and ready to make a difference. If that sounds like you, you can win at Wilsonart.*

*Wilsonart is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, military status, order of protection status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.*

**Pacific Coast Producers |** Full-Time | On-Site | Exempt 
**Salary Range:** $160,000- $200,000 /year (based on experience)

**Pacific Coast Producers** (PCP), a growing agricultural cooperative with food production facilities across the West Coast, is seeking an experienced and strategic **Plant Manager** to lead our Production Facility **in Lodi, CA**. PCP is dedicated to investing in its people and fostering a culture of service, where each employee can do their best to make affordable, high-quality food for customers across North America.

Join our legacy of talented people working together to innovate and lead our industry. As a member of PCP, you will have access to a comprehensive benefits package that includes top-quality, medical, dental, and vision insurance, generous paid time off, and a retirement savings plan to help secure your future.

The Plant Manager will have overall accountability for directing and managing plant operations to meet quality, food safety, and customer requirements in a safe, cost-effective, and timely manner. The plant employs over 800 employees during the processing season and maintains an experienced year-round staff. The Plant Manager reports directly to the Director of Operations.

**What You'll Do:**

* Lead all aspects of plant operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production
* Develop and execute production plans aligned with raw material supply, demand, labor, and plant capacity
* Drive performance against key metrics including safety, quality, throughput, and cost
* Own operating and capital budgets; analyzing performance and implementing corrective actions
* Champion food safety, environmental compliance, and regulatory adherence (OSHA, FDA, SQF, HACCP, HARPC, GMPs)
* Build, coach, and develop strong teams through clear expectations and consistent leadership
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, reliability, and profitability
* Partner effectively with union leadership to maintain a positive and productive work environment
* Oversee capital projects and internal investments to support future growth and operational excellence

**What You Bring to the Team:**

* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in food manufacturing including aseptic processing, canning, or similar method.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or related field
* Proven ability to lead large teams in a fast-paced, unionized setting
* Proven experience with process flows, automated controls, review of AutoCAD drawings, and dealing with industrial processing equipment vendors and mechanical contractors.
* Strong operational and financial acumen, including budgeting and performance analysis
* Demonstrated success driving continuous improvement and leading change
* Deep understanding of food safety systems and regulatory requirements (GFSI, HACCP, HARPC, FDA, OSHA)
* Hands-on leadership style with strong problem-solving capability
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results under tight timelines
* Strong communication skills with the ability to influence across all levels of the organization

**Why Join PCP?**

At PCP, we take care of our people. Here are just a few of the benefits full-time employees enjoy:

* **Competitive pay** with opportunities for advancement.
* **This position is eligible for our annual profit-sharing bonus program**.
* **Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, starting the first of the month after you join us.**
* **Retirement plans** to support your long-term security.
* **Paid time off** including vacation, holidays, parental leave, sick leave, and bereavement.
* **Life and disability insurance** plus an Employee Assistance Program.
* **Development opportunities** through online courses, classroom training, and on-the-job growth.
* The stability of a **farmer-owned cooperative** with more than 50 years of success.
* A mission-driven culture focused on **feeding families across North America.**

**Salary Range: $160,000 - $200,000/year (based on experience).** This is a **full-time, on-site** role based at our production facility Lodi, CA.

The base salary range reflects the reasonable expectation for what the company anticipates paying for this role at the time of posting. The actual salary offered will depend on factors including, but not limited to:

* Relevant skills, education, and experience
* Job-related qualifications and certifications
* Internal pay equity
* Market conditions and business needs

**Sponsorship:** This role is not eligible for current or future visa sponsorship.

**About PCP Summary**

Founded in 1971, Pacific Coast Producers is owned by more than 165 family farmers who cultivate and deliver a diverse range of crops including tomatoes, peaches, pears, grapes, cherries, and more. Our cooperative operates multiple processing and packaging facilities across the West Coast, supplying top-quality products to grocery retailers and foodservice distributors throughout the U.S. and Canada.

Our Lodi Production facility is a bustling hub where delicious apples, peaches, and apricots are transformed into high-quality products. The facility is equipped with advanced machinery and cutting-edge technology, enabling efficient and precise sorting, peeling, and slicing of the fruits. Meticulous attention is paid to every step of the process, ensuring that only the finest fruits make their way into the final products.

Nestled in the heart of San Joaquin County and just a short 45-minute drive from Sacramento, our Production Facility is located in the charming city of Lodi, CA. Lodi is renowned for its rich history in winemaking and agriculture, as well as its vibrant downtown area and close-knit community. With a great quality of life, Lodi offers a welcoming environment to those seeking a relaxed and enjoyable lifestyle.

**AA/EEO Policy Statement**

Pacific Coast Producers is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. No employee or applicant will be discriminated against in any condition of employment because of race, color, national origin, sex, religion, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

card.title: Plant Manager
card.description:
*Are you a passionate leader energized by driving continuous improvement?* ***Winnebago Motorhome is seeking a Plant Manager to join our team based in Forest City, IA.*** *The Plant Manager leads overall operations of a soft goods manufacturing facility (cut-and-sew, upholstery, foam, and textile assembly). This expert-level role owns safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people (SQDCP) performance, deploying lean manufacturing systems (5S, Standard Work, Visual Management, Kaizen) and ensuring compliance with relevant standards (RVIA, OSHA, NFPA 1192, ANSI methods as applicable). Responsibilities include strategic planning, capacity and labor management, production scheduling, quality systems oversight, supplier and materials coordination, cross-department alignment, and talent development to achieve world-class operational results.*

**Day to Day of the Role:**

* Own plant SQDCP performance; establish and drive KPIs and tiered daily management (Safety, OEE, FPY, on-time delivery, productivity, scrap, rework, etc).
* Lead daily Tier 1-3 process, Gemba walks, huddles, and visual management; drive corrective actions and sustainment.
* Implement and sustain lean systems: 5S, Standard Work, Kanban/pull systems, value stream mapping, line balancing, takt-time alignment, TPM. (Lean Six Sigma Blackbelt Preferred but not required)
* Ensure compliance with industry and regulatory requirements: Industry and lean best practices, RVIA, OSHA, EHS, NFPA 1192, and ANSI methods as applicable.
* Oversee master scheduling, capacity planning, labor planning, and materials flow to meet demand with optimal lead time and cost.
* Champion quality: PFMEA/Control Plans, incoming/in-process/final inspection, root cause analysis (8D, DMAIC), containment, and standardization.
* Optimize cutting, kitting, sewing, upholstery, and final assembly workflows; reduce WIP, increase throughput, and minimize waste.
* Manage budget, P&L elements, cost reduction, and productivity projects; implement make/buy and outsourcing strategies as needed.
* Build and mentor high-performing supervisors and hourly teams; certify skills; conduct performance reviews; drive cross-training and succession planning.
* Partner with Engineering on DFM/DFA; manage ECNs, prototypes, and ramp-to-rate.
* Own, develop, and mentor best practices for inventory and processes.
* Collaborate with Supply Chain on supplier performance, material availability, and packaging standards.
* Enforce safety culture: risk assessments (JSA), ergonomics, PPE, incident investigations, and compliance training.
* Lead continuous improvement events (Kaizen) and audits; maintain document control and training records.
* Coordinate with Customer Service/Program Management for priorities, promise dates, and escalations; communicate status and recovery plans.

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field preferred.
* Associate’s degree with significant relevant experience will also be considered.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations.
* 7–10+ years of people management experience, including leading teams through change.
* Moderate to in-depth knowledge of Tools, Machines, or Equipment Required (Mechanical and digital measuring and inspection tools, tape, calipers, tension gauges, fabric weight/yardage tools, color/finish checks).
* ERP (D365) or similar modern Operations and Finance manufacturing software
* Basic office systems for analytics, drawings/specs, and work instructions.
* Practical understanding and ability to perform with Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, NX & Team Center (or similar engineering software)
